reason: A property of the ID scheme rather than a repository rule; the durable fix would be allocation authority in agent-learning, and one collision is not enough evidence for that.
remaining_uncertainty: Whether agent-learning should allocate finding IDs rather than leaving the sequence to whoever writes the file. One collision is not enough evidence to change a scheme every existing record uses.

validation_case.given: two branches allocating finding IDs from the same per-day sequence
validation_case.when: both land records with the same ID and the pull-request merge is validated
validation_case.then: learn validate fails with a duplicate finding ID, and the branch that arrived second renumbers inside its rebase
